text:
Silver Price in 1975
Among 12 monthly observations available for 1975, the LBMA silver price rose 0.7% between 1975-01-31 ($4.15) and 1975-12-31 ($4.18). The highest sampled price was $5.00 in July and the lowest was $4.15 in January. The mean of these observations was $4.42. This is a first-to-last observation change, not a calendar-year return.
